tasks.payload: W11 authored staging/W11.inc and W11.test.cpp. Limits: Attribute keys/node relationships and inherited inputs are explicit, no W10 grammar inference; dependency graphs rebuilt for runs/targeted invalidation; session state and definitions are snapshots and aliased state requires explicit invalidation. Host C++ purity/monotonicity/lattice laws are contractual, not proved; trusted arbitrary host callbacks are not preempted by engine budgets. Procedure registry is typed by State/Value (use a variant for heterogeneous binding values), and only explicit transform calls may reach effectful callbacks; side effects of C++ transforms cannot be rolled back. Diagnostic rules match supplied subject, not automatic AST traversal; fix text is literal and range is supplied by caller. Independent of W10/W12.

blockers.payload: Limits: Unicode 16, East Asian ambiguous characters narrow, deterministic width estimate (not font/palette detection), hard wrapping only; style restoration applies to DSL scopes, not unknown ambient style. Native/raw trusted escape opt-in bypasses guarantees; unsupported DCS and DEC-extension actions have public protocol constants but no textual arbitrary command. Hyperlinks allow only control-free HTTP(S). Capability flags explicit, no live terminal probe. UTF-8 terminals required for non-ASCII display.
Preferred temporary filesystem /mnt/andromeda is full (ENOSPC); switching W03 isolated verification to user-coordinated /dev/shm.

W12 limits: verification obligations are explicit metadata, not generated or discharged symbolic theorem proofs; runtime snapshots and frame conditions are caller-defined and not transactional. Trusted native callbacks must honor pure/deterministic intent and bound their internal work. Optimizer adapts existing term rewriting with trusted equivalence gate and non-growing forms, not general effect inference or proof search. Lisp is a small lexical closure example with no named letrec, live global cells, or guaranteed TCO; stack transition example is generic, not a full SECD/CESK implementation.

No implementation blockers. Intentional scope: directory-tree databases only; passive discovery, no active probe/terminal write, and resize observed by polling or caller SIGWINCH. Preferred /mnt/andromeda temp filesystem was full; used /tmp for test build artifacts.

Hygiene is explicit (fresh NAME) for macro-generated bindings/references; bare introduced identifiers use the object language’s own scoping, not automatic definition-site lexical marks. Provenance is structural paths + canonical rule index, not source byte spans. Expression/statement/attribute/metaproc bodies are canonical SExpr descriptors consumed by a chosen semantics adapter, not automatically linked to W11/W12 or statically type-checked. Built-in schema types are closed; custom state effects run only via explicit trusted native registration. Interpreter limits meter its own work, not trusted primitive bodies; CFG parsing retains existing CFG executor behavior.

W09 limits: process support requires a guarded POSIX implementation with atomic CLOEXEC sockets and SIGPIPE suppression; dedicated pipes and shm_open/pread/pwrite implementation are Linux-only. Older glibc may require -pthread/-lrt when Runner is linked; on platforms without addclosefrom_np host controls CLOEXEC of unrelated descriptors. Explicitly trusted runner is not a sandbox: process groups bound ordinary descendant lifetime, not deliberate detach; host must not auto-reap or externally reap the runner child. A kernel-blocked spawn/kill/reap can exceed the user-space poll deadline. Hooks are explicit host adapters; analysis does not launch scripts implicitly.

Native callback cancellation is cooperative (including host-provided filesystem/script providers); textual analysis has no script capability. W07 can install W08 newline indentation via editor hook, but auto-continuation submit currently inserts a plain newline. Shared /mnt/andromeda/tempdir filesystem was full; used TMPDIR=/dev/shm for verified builds.

W07 limits: Emacs/Vi subsets rather than full emulators; no process-global signal handler. Cooperative stop tokens cannot preempt blocking user I/O/evaluation; Ctrl-C clears idle TTY input, while a synchronous evaluator needs a caller-owned stop source to stop mid-call. Sessions are single-thread-owned. An explicit ANSI-capable native terminal is required for redraw; width is W05 estimate, with a clipped viewport instead of terminal-specific reflow. History persistence format uses caller-owned I/O (paths/atomicity/permissions are host policy); load does not restore per-draft undo. W04 hard-bounded partial/overlong paste can be dropped before editor insertion; no truncated data is evaluated automatically.

Reviewed optic is deliberately limited: AST root-only candidates, SExpr/TermGraph exact syntax roundtrip, flat e-matching LHS, small fixed engine ceilings. Whole-domain proof/subject membership and concrete result/effect/trap observations are separate trusted host obligations; no automatic equivalence checker or effect inference. No partial candidate on limit.

No active W02 blockers. Limits: wrapper locations are source envelopes for the root (not automatic child ranges or cross-revision IDs); source/origin/node IDs are instance-local. Fixed-arena cap applies only to PMR allocations, not legacy AST/SExpr values, diagnostic payloads, or retained callback targets. Fixed arenas do not roll back consumed bytes after a failed allocation sequence. Borrowed buffers/resources and borrowed upstream PMRs must outlive their users.
